name: echo facepalm
description: Proposal, the facepalm gesture (no words, no one's art), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x): the creature rests and blinks, its eyes go flat and unimpressed, then its right forearm rises diagonally from the arm stub in three slow steps to an open palm seen flat, four short fingers and a thumb nub, that lands over the right of its visor with three small strokes flicking up, a sliver of the band showing past it; its whole body drops a row and its antenna droops over, it holds there most of two seconds with one slow sigh and a small puff, then the hand drags down its face over eyes shut flat, drops away, and the head comes back up still unimpressed, a slow blink, the rest; judge whether the open hand reads as a hand over the face, whether the hold reads as weary rather than still, and whether it is still this creature.
